lines.en: I pace the village gate with my shield
My short legs move briskly
My scabbard knocks my leg
I patrol along the palisade
I circle a cookfire
I walk the village's dirt track
I pass a rack of mushrooms
I nod at a fellow guard
I shuffle over to the gate
My shadow jumps on the posts
I tap the shield rim as I go
I pass under the watchtower
I circle to the back wall
I crouch with my shield
I am honing the blade right now
I stare off toward the trees
I chew a strip of dried meat
I rest the shield on my knee
I count who passes
My nose twitches twice
I slide the sword back in its sheath
I wait to be relieved
I cinch my belt
I tap my helmet with a finger
I turn the shield over to check it
I raise my shield in front of me
Halt, go no further
My hand rests on my hilt
You do not look like a goblin
I watch you over my shield
This village does not welcome you
Put your weapon away

lines.zh: 我朝旁边的同伴看了眼
lines.en: I glance at the guard beside me
You are taller than me, and it does not matter
Keep off the mushroom racks

lines.zh: 我的剑比盾短，可够得着。
lines.en: My sword is shorter than my shield, but it reaches.
I cough to clear my throat
I tilt my head at your purpose
I put my body in the gateway
I swear under my breath
My shield held, but my arm went numb.
I press the cut
The blow nearly shook my sword loose.
I bring the shield back up
I clamp my teeth hard
My helmet is crooked again
I can keep fighting
I edge back toward the gate
I take nothing from outsiders
Set the food down, then
I look at it and do not take it
That is not a meal
I would rather have coins
You push the meat closer
Wait until the watch changes
Take a bite first, let me see
I cannot eat on duty
You ran into my shield
I drop my weight and hold

lines.zh: 哥布林骑士的盾，把你顶开。
lines.en: The goblin knight's shield shoves you aside.
My helmet is knocked askew
I look at you from behind the shield
Push me, I stay put
The soil shifts under me
That one you brought on yourself
I reset my footing
There are plenty of she-goblins here
I only mind this gate
I will talk to her after my watch
I once brought her a piece of meat
We live in the same row of huts
She hones her blade faster than me
My duty is not done
That would need the chief's word
Goblins are not fussy about this
I pick up coins off the ground
This one has a chipped edge
I tuck it in my belt pouch
I find a handful of old nails
These could fix the palisade
This belongs to the village
I will hand it to the store
I shove it behind my shield strap
I keep it as a spare
You took a step toward the gate
I raise shield and blade
Then do not blame me
You stepped into our ground
I strike the shield twice
My fellows will hear that
I have your feet marked
I level my blade
I will be the one to stop you
I edge around the gateway
One step back, I take one forward
My shield stays in front
I wait for you to miss
Shield up first, then the counter.
I do not chase, I hold
You cannot enter this stretch
I block with the shield's corner
I point my blade at you
I have not moved from this gate
My blade stabs out from the shield
I drive the shield into your knee
My edge bites your armor
The point opens your sleeve
I smash your hand with the shield rim
I duck in under your guard
I slash twice
You stopped the shield, not the sword
This one comes from below
My point rests on your chest
I step out from behind the palisade
I bring my shield to my chest
The gate post is mine now
I kick the dirt off my boots
I tighten my helmet strap
I signal to my fellows
I take my stand in the gateway

lines.zh: 我的手已经搭在剑柄上
lines.en: My hand is already on my hilt
The village bell rings once

lines.zh: 火燎焦了我胳膊上的毛
lines.en: Fire singes the hair on my arm
I land and my helmet rolls away

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我直挣
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I thrash
The blast throws me into the palisade
An arrow sticks in my shoulder plate
I have not had my meal yet

lines.zh: 雷击让我半边身子发木
lines.en: The strike leaves half of me numb
I fall still gripping my sword
